purpose: Teach: 社説/説教/白書/争点/若年/文学部/一帯/操業

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、新聞の、本気で、絶対、社説、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Ren, the way you handled newspaper editorials in your paper was genuinely impressive.
lines.style: Warm, steady encouragement. Slight lean forward. Genuine admiration in the voice without effusiveness. Eyes meeting his. Brief pause before the compliment lands.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。宗教家の、本気で、絶対、説教、絶対、伝統、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I tried to tackle how religious figures use sermons as a lens for understanding tradition — it was important research for me.
lines.style: Respectful, earnest. Speaks with careful precision. Slight formality in his tone, genuine gratitude underneath. Doesn't rush the thought. Slight ducking of his head in humility.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 政府の、本気で、絶対、白書、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And you covered government white papers with real thoughtfulness. That's the kind of depth that shows.
lines.style: Reflective, appreciative. Speaking as someone noticing something important. Measured pace. Not just praising — observing. Slight nod, recognition in her eyes.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。選挙の、本気で、絶対、争点、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Election issues felt central to understanding the broader picture, so I made sure to explore those thoroughly.
lines.style: Measured, careful. Explaining his choices without defensiveness. Quiet conviction in his voice. The precision of someone who knows what he examined and why. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 本気で、絶対、若年、絶対、層の、絶対、政治、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: What really struck me was how you examined young voters — how politics actually reaches that demographic.
lines.style: Engaged, noticing something fresh. Slight lift in her voice. Not asking, but observing aloud. The warmth of a teacher watching a student think clearly. Leaning slightly forward with genuine interest.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。大学、本気で、絶対、文学部、絶対、の、絶対、伝統、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. The university's literature department has this rich tradition, and I wanted to respect that foundation while examining how it connects to real political questions.
lines.style: Earnest, reverent almost. Careful articulation. Speaking with gratitude and seriousness in equal measure. The voice of someone who has thought this through and means it. Slight pause between clauses.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地域、本気で、絶対、一帯、絶対、の、絶対、文化、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The cultural context of the whole region — that's what made the research hold together.
lines.style: Reflective, drawing a line of connection. Thoughtful pace. Speaking to something she's noticed: how his work didn't exist in isolation. Quiet recognition. Almost thinking aloud.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。工場の、本気で、絶対、操業、絶対、影響、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes — examining how factory operations shaped that culture helped ground everything. It felt necessary to understand the full impact.
lines.style: Quiet conclusion to the thought. Earnest, careful. The finality of someone who has worked through something and come to rest on it. Slight fade on the last phrase. Genuine gratitude present but subdued.
